overview: Fia’s design uses recessed balconies and a restrained façade. Within the wider Town Square neighbourhood, the central park and community shops complement the development’s advertised pool, play and barbecue spaces.
research.locationNote: Town Square, Dubai. The developer describes access to the community park, shops and walking/cycling routes.
research.priceNote: Property Finder’s actual project record quotes AED 780,888, while a cached search headline shows AED 850,000. The figure is a historical launch reference; it does not confirm an available home.
